readout_other: compound action potentials of sciatic nerve branches; CMAP of tibialis anterior and gastrocnemius; LFP spectra and PSD in M1; AIM dyskinesia scores
direction_notes: Meta-lens focusing raised sciatic CAP amplitude (357 to 5,460 uV at 300 cycles) and allowed selective peroneal versus tibial activation. In 6-OHDA PD rats, daily STN ultrasound with L-DOPA reduced AIM scores and abolished the high-gamma LFP peak seen with L-DOPA alone.
safety_notes: Ultrasound output was paused for 4 s after every 2 s of stimulation to avoid local temperature rise in the nerve experiment.

exposures.label: Meta-skin lens, peroneal and tibial nerve bundles

target.label: sciatic nerves (peroneal and tibial nerve bundles)

device.model: meta-skin acoustic meta-lens sealed in hydrogel with a piezo-transducer

timing.protocol_description: Periodic electric pulses with a repetition period of 1 ms, each pulse containing 100 to 550 cycles (increased from 100 to 550 in steps of 50; 300 cycles for the lens comparison); ultrasound output paused for 4 s after every 2 s of stimulation. Frequency varied to shift focal depth.

exposures.label: Meta-skin lens through skull, subthalamic nucleus (PD rats)

device.model: meta-skin acoustic meta-lens sealed in hydrogel with a piezo-transducer

timing.protocol_description: 30 min of daily ultrasound stimulation followed by an L-DOPA injection, for 14 days; pulse timing for the STN experiment is not stated.

source_quotes.exposures[1].fundamental_frequency_khz: The measured focal spot size is approximately 220 μm (subwavelength scale at 5 MHz)
source_quotes.exposures[1].in_situ.pressure_kpa: The measured focal spot size is approximately 220 μm (subwavelength scale at 5 MHz), and the sound pressure is about 0.54 MPa.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_repetition_fre: Figure 2 B displays the periodic electric pulses input to the meta-skin-based instrument, for which the pulse repetition frequency is 1 ms and each pulse contains 100 to 550 cycles.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: To present the unwanted rise in local tissue temperature during stimulation, the ultrasound output was paused for 4 s after every 2 s of stimulations (the tempera ture at the ultrasound stimulation site was maintained at 25 °C).
source_quotes.n_subjects: 20 PD rats were divided into 2 groups of 10. The first group received 30 min of daily ultrasound stimulation, followed by an L-DOPA injection (L-DOPA, 12 mg/kg; benserazide, 6 mg/kg), which is termed as the L-DOPA + US group.
